risk_flags.message: Custody data in use is the July 2026 attestation, 79d old (threshold 45d); latest published (custodian-attestations-of-assets-backing-usde-september-3) is 0d old

A newer attestation (custodian-attestations-of-assets-backing-usde-september-3) is published than the embedded snapshot (custodian-attestations-of-assets-backing-usde-july-3) — the per-custodian breakdown AND disclosed wallet roster remain unverified. A matching wallet set is NOT sufficient to clear this flag because custody composition can move while addresses stay put

backing.basis: Anchored on this analyzer's own flags: COVERAGE_WARN 1.0 (par) -> 4/5, COVERAGE_CRIT 0.98 -> 2/5, and par + COVERAGE_DRIFT_PP (2.0pp) -> 5/5. A delta-neutral synthetic targets par, not 130%, so the generic scale rates its design state 3/5 'Watch'. A WARN below par can no longer coexist with a 4/5.
backing.expires_reason: Par and two flag thresholds; none drifts.

liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: A FLOOR, not a measurement. The deepest rung quoted ($5,000,000) still clears inside 200bps, so the crossing is somewhere above where we look. Publishing it as '2% depth' would read as a limit we found. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.

depth_50bps.basis: A FLOOR, not a measurement. The deepest rung quoted ($5,000,000) still clears inside 50bps, so the crossing is somewhere above where we look. Publishing it as '0.5% depth' would read as a limit we found. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.

liquidity.scope: Routed across every venue kyberswap reaches on ethereum, selling into USDC. ⚠️ ONE CHAIN — depth on other chains is not included and is not implied to be zero.

exit_mark.slippage_bps_basis: PRICE IMPACT against this venue's own smallest quoted rung, which EXCLUDES that rung's own spread — it is not the holder's all-in cost. The all-in figure is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Impact is measured this way deliberately, so peg discount and source lag do not leak into it.

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Backing / supply INCLUDING the reserve fund (coverage_ratio_with_reserve_fund x 100). The conservative coverage excluding the reserve fund is in backing.secondary and sits lower; the two diverge precisely when the fund is absorbing something. ⚠️ USDe is delta-neutral, not overcollateralised: par is the design target, so the generic [130,110,100,90] rates its intended state 'Watch'. Cutoffs are anchored on this analyzer's own COVERAGE_WARN (1.0) and COVERAGE_CRIT (0.98).
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: Implied by the rated ratio: total_backing - total_backing/(collateral_ratio/100), i.e. the surplus INCLUDING the reserve fund. ⚠️ NOT total_backing - total_supply, which excludes the fund and is published as surplus_deficit_ex_reserve_fund.
